barriers.title: Tritium Scarcity
barriers.detail: ~25kg global supply. Lithium blanket breeding unproven at commercial scale.

barriers.title: Materials Degradation
barriers.detail: Neutron bombardment degrades structural components faster than fission. No material validated for full commercial duty cycle. EU €340M research program launched Jan 2026.

barriers.title: Timeline Slippage History
barriers.detail: ITER over $22B and years behind. Fusion timelines have historically slipped by 5-10 years across all major programs.

barriers.title: Net Energy Positive at Grid Scale
barriers.detail: NIF achieved ignition in 2022 but energy output was laser-input dependent. Commercial energy positive remains undemonstrated at utility scale.

milestone_banner.text: KSTAR achieved 48-second plasma sustainment at 100 million degrees in June 2026, while LLNL and Pacific Fusion reached 3,000-shot milestone with Sirius pulsed-power prototype in July 2026.

kstar.name: KSTAR
kstar.description: KSTAR extended 100-million-degree plasma operation to 48 seconds in June 2026, setting a new record in full tungsten environment. Ongoing experiments continue toward the 300-second plasma hold goal.

cfs.name: Commonwealth Fusion
cfs.description: CFS closed $1B funding round from pension funds, bringing total capital raised to $4B. SPARC construction continues in Devens with 2027 first plasma target while ARC commercial plant advances toward Chesterfield, Virginia site.

helion.name: Helion Energy
helion.description: Helion achieved 150 million degree plasma temperature milestone in February 2026, advancing toward 2028 first power target. Company continues negotiations for OpenAI power deal alongside existing Microsoft PPA while progressing Polaris construction.

tae.name: TAE Technologies / TMTG
tae.description: TAE-TMTG $6B merger proceeds with Truth Social spinoff cancelled and integrated company structure confirmed. Jeff Woodbury appointed TAE President/COO as parties maintain mid-2026 close timeline pending SEC S-4 review.

iter.name: ITER
iter.description: Sixth tokamak sector module (1,100-ton core component) lowered into place, advancing vacuum vessel assembly. Assembly progress continues on track toward 2027 first plasma target.

east.name: EAST / China Program
east.description: EAST tokamak exceeded the Greenwald density limit in January 2026, achieving plasma densities previously considered theoretically impossible. China continues advancing high-density plasma research as a global leader in sustained fusion experiments.

timeline.title: Merger Announced
timeline.detail: All-stock deal signed. Boards approved. DJT stock +33% on day of.

timeline.title: $200M Cash to TAE at Signing
timeline.detail: Additional $100M available on SEC Form S-4 filing.

timeline.title: Shareholder + Regulatory Close
timeline.detail: SEC S-4 review ongoing. Truth Social spinoff cancelled; integrated company structure confirmed. Jeff Woodbury appointed TAE President/COO. Trump Jr. joins board. Mid-2026 close target reaffirmed.

timeline.title: Plant Site Selection Begins
timeline.detail: Nunes stated site search begins after deal closes.

timeline.title: First Power Generation Target
timeline.detail: TAE's stated goal for first electricity from utility-scale plant.
